format: Studio / Custom divisions (all Competition OS event types for the gate)
requirement: Studio / Custom eligibility (age division, amateur or professional status, level) is determined by the organizer. An entry in a division that uses a classification is not ready until an authorized event manager records a determination (user id, actor role, timestamp, outcome, reason code, criteria confirmed; no sensitive detail). Divisions that use no classification require none. Waivers cover event-policy matters only and never override age, status, level, membership, registration or the OD-02 under-18 restriction. Copy never claims DanceFlow verified NDCA registration, UCWDC membership or WSDC Points Registry eligibility.
enforcement_point: Server: updateCompetitionEntryEligibilityAction (authorized event managers only; required criteria derived from stored division labels and participant roles) and loadEntryOperationalGates in heat generation, floor planning and readiness.

tests.name: combination sweep: ready only when ALL of adult, applicable criteria and a permitted decision hold
every prohibited override subject is refused by a gate

interpretation_notes: Partially implemented, so not marked verified; the OD-03 gaps apply (entry confirmation inside the finalize SQL is not gated, check-in still uses the older test, determinations live in entries.metadata with no append-only history). Status applicability is derived from participant roles professional/student; level from the division skill label; both are DanceFlow organizer policy, not body definitions. Criteria are self-attested by the organizer; DanceFlow checks only that the organizer confirmed every applicable criterion. The 'authorized organizer or designated official' is any event manager (studio owner/admin, organizer owner/admin/staff, platform admin); no finer 'designated official' role exists.
